shortDescription: Haiti authorities on Friday confirmed gang leader Mathias Saintil was dead, after Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aime said on X there was "one less gang leader.""The fight to free the country from the grip of bandits continues with determination," Fils-Aime added.
